title: Graft surface
description: The extension contract a host adapter publishes for one host version: slots, capabilities, permission scopes and migrations from the previous surface. Identified by its content hash.

hash.description: Content hash of the contract (everything except hash, hostVersion, previous and migrations, canonical JSON, SHA-256). Verified when present.

fingerprint.description: Host-computed fingerprint of the host half (structure only, no text, version or roles). The plugin uses it at runtime to find the snapshot it matches.

previous.description: Content hash of the surface the migrations start from.

audiences.description: Audience values a spec may use (for WordPress: role slugs).

model.description: The host's content model the surface was generated from, in a host-defined shape (for WordPress: the exposed post types with their fields and taxonomies). Verification sandboxes use it to reproduce the site. Part of the contract, so it is hashed.

triggers.description: What builds may do without a viewer (ADR 0010): the host events and capabilities triggers may use, and the bounds every trigger runs within. Absent when the host runs no triggers.

jsonSchema.description: An embedded JSON Schema (draft 2020-12). Adapters normalize host schemas (e.g. draft-04 ability schemas) into this.

kind.description: owned: the customization gets its own space. extension: it attaches to an existing host screen.

screen.description: Host screen an extension slot lives on.

anchor.description: Host hook or component the slot attaches to. What re-anchoring replaces.

provides.description: Props the slot passes to the UI, e.g. the current post id.

successor.description: Slot that replaces this one if it is deprecated.

scopes.description: Permission scopes a grant must include to call this capability.

binding.description: Host-specific binding, e.g. { ability: 'graft/posts-list' }. Opaque to the core.

host.description: Host permissions the scope maps to (for WordPress: capabilities). Opaque to the core.

identity.description: Plain-language name of the identity triggers run as, shown to the admin who approves them.

maxPerRun.description: Most capability calls one run may make; also the default per-run cap.

maxEventRunsPerHour.description: Most runs one event trigger may start in an hour; later events are dropped and logged.

capabilities.description: Capabilities a trigger may call, to select targets or act on them. Anything else is refused unattended.

events.description: Host events a trigger may run on, each with the subject it passes as the trigger's target.

provides.description: Schema of the event's subject: the target.
